extracted.intended_audience: postdoctoral scientists aiming to transition to tenure-track/independent faculty positions (potential applicants to the Hanna H. Gray Fellows / Freeman Hrabowski Scholars Program)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and eligibility information for applicants seeking Hanna H. Gray Fellowship support as they transition from postdoctoral training to independent, tenure-track faculty positions; in 2026 applications are made as part of the Freeman Hrabowski Scholars Program. Describes who may apply, the program's aims, what support is provided, and timing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility — Postdoctoral readiness and institutional eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Postdoctoral scientists ready to start their independent research program; must be from an eligible institution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See the page's 'Eligible Institutions' resource for the list of qualifying institutions. The program is targeted at postdocs who are prepared to launch an independent research program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timing — Transition window (within two years of pursuing an independent, tenure-track faculty position)
rubrics_metrics.description: In 2026, postdoctoral scientists within two years of pursuing an independent, tenure-track faculty position will apply to be Hanna Gray Fellows as part of the Freeman Hrabowski Scholars Program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should assess their career timeline to ensure they fall within this two-year window when the competition opens; timing is integral to eligibility for the 2026 competition cycle.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection emphasis — exceptional promise, leadership, foundational research, and inclusive scientific cultures
rubrics_metrics.description: The Hanna H. Gray Fellows Program is a transformational award for postdoctoral scientists who show exceptional promise as future leaders in academic science, advancing foundational discoveries while fostering inclusive scientific cultures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection priorities emphasize leadership potential, capacity to advance foundational discoveries, and commitment to fostering inclusive scientific environments. Applicants should position their materials to reflect these attributes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support components — salary, research funding, and professional development
rubrics_metrics.description: Support Includes: Salary, research funding, and professional development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Award resources include direct salary support, research project funding, and tailored professional development opportunities; Fellows also gain access to HHMI community resources, meetings, and peer networks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Duration of award — postdoctoral and faculty support lengths
rubrics_metrics.description: Under this new structure, Hanna Gray Fellows will receive up to two years of postdoctoral support, and up to ten years of faculty support as Freeman Hrabowski Scholars.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Historically the program provided up to four years postdoc and up to four years after launching independent labs; applicants should note the updated durations and the linked faculty-support pathway via the Freeman Hrabowski Scholars Program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Competition frequency and timeline
rubrics_metrics.description: Competition Frequency: Biannual, next competition opens November 3, 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should plan ahead for the biannual cycle and sign up for program/competition emails to receive announcements and deadlines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application pathway — integration with the Freeman Hrabowski Scholars Program
rubrics_metrics.description: In 2026, applicants will apply to be Hanna Gray Fellows as part of the Freeman Hrabowski Scholars Program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For additional details on application mechanics, eligibility, and the combined program structure, applicants are directed to the Freeman Hrabowski Scholars webpage and associated resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community engagement and professional development expectation
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellows are part of an active network of more than 100 current program participants and the broader HHMI scientific community; they connect via collaborations and HHMI Science Meetings and access tailored training to build thriving research environments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should be prepared to participate in community activities, mentorship, and professional-development offerings; demonstrating how they will engage and contribute to the community may strengthen an application.
